title.zh: v1.1.0：ME 积分体系与 Studio 全新体验
title.en: v1.1.0: ME Credits System and the New Studio Experience

content.zh:
## 欢迎升级到 IDBots v1.1.0

本版本引入 **ME 积分体系**，并对桌面端体验做了一次大升级。

### ME 积分：官方能力的统一计量

- **官方模型对话、JEV 小脑决策、上链流量**现在消耗 ME 积分，不再直接消耗账户内的其他资源
- 每周自动发放**免费积分**；订阅档位越高，每周额度越大
- 积分不足时会**自动回退到各自身份钱包自付**，任务不会中断
- 新增 **设置 > 积分 & 流量** 面板：实时余额、本周发放、用量明细一目了然
- 订阅面板新增 **积分增量包**（可开启自动扣减）与 **PayPal / 支付宝** 订阅支付

### 本次其他亮点

- **Studio** 全新上线：实时舞台（Live Stage）、Genesis 欢迎页、投影极速档、会话与浏览器标签页绑定
- Bot Browser 集成 **元素选取器**（Agent Browser Core 0.10.2），精准指认页面元素
- **MRC-721** 开放市场、兑换引擎与零确认发布流程
- 定时任务可延续**同一会话**执行；长期任务心跳不再分裂出新会话
- 大量稳定性修复：流式断线自愈、渲染守护、安装器与自动更新加固

### 温馨提示

积分余额与用量可在 **设置 > 积分 & 流量** 随时查看；如对订阅或计费有疑问，请在设置页联系客服入口。
content.en:
## Welcome to IDBots v1.1.0

This release introduces the **ME credits system** and ships a major desktop experience upgrade.

### ME Credits: One Meter for Official Capabilities

- **Official model conversations, JEV cerebellum decisions, and on-chain traffic** now consume ME credits instead of drawing on other account resources
- **Free credits are granted weekly**; higher subscription tiers get larger weekly allowances
- When credits run out, tasks **automatically fall back to each identity's own wallet self-pay** and never stall
- A new **Settings > Credits & Traffic** panel shows your live balance, weekly grant, and usage details
- The subscription panel adds **credit packs** (with an auto-deduct toggle) and **PayPal / Alipay** subscription checkout

### Other Highlights

- **Studio** debuts: Live Stage, a Genesis welcome page, projection fast mode, and session-to-browser-tab binding
- The Bot Browser integrates an **element picker** (Agent Browser Core 0.10.2) for precise page-element targeting
- **MRC-721** open market, swap engine, and zero-confirmation publishing
- Scheduled tasks can continue in **one standing conversation**; long-term task heartbeats no longer fork new sessions
- Many stability fixes: mid-stream reconnect self-healing, a renderer hang watchdog, and installer/updater hardening

### Good to Know

Check your balance and usage anytime under **Settings > Credits & Traffic**; for billing questions, use the support entry on the settings page.
